_what: What a zip archive may hand an importer, as DATA read by src/archive-entries.mjs. `media_types` maps a lowercase file extension to the media type an entry is admitted as; an entry with any other extension is left out. `skip` are path patterns of archive litter that are never entries. The limits bound one archive: `max_entries` admitted entries, `max_entry_bytes` for one entry's bytes, `max_total_bytes` for all of them, and `max_ratio` the most an entry may expand beyond its compressed size. `profiles` are named overrides of the limits and the admitted types for one importer (chat_export: the conversations*.json files of an account export, src/chat-import.mjs); `title_prefix` keeps only entries whose title starts with it.
